explanation: B combines sufficient ReLU depth and width to resolve the one-turn spiral with late LayerNorm that maintains useful feature and gradient scales at the very small learning rate. A has good residual gradient flow, but its smooth SiLU features are likely to develop the required curved separation more slowly within this budget. C's deeper, unnormalized nonresidual stack attenuates signals and gradients under default initialization, delaying learning and confidence growth. B therefore has the strongest expected test cross-entropy.
